title: Astrid and the Letters
author: Dominic Eriksen
blurb: Lior Brightwater, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
